description: DHCP option 60 (Vendor Class Identifier), matched with a regular expression against the whole value. Signatures are tried in order and the first match wins.

signatures.label: android
signatures.notes: Android 10 and later put the major version in the vendor class.

signatures.label: android
signatures.notes: Android 4.x to 9 used dhcpcd 5.2 or 5.5 and sent only the bare dhcpcd version. Desktop dhcpcd builds append :OS-RELEASE:MACHINE:PLATFORM.

signatures.label: linux
signatures.notes: Other dhcpcd builds (Raspberry Pi OS, Arch, Gentoo), which send dhcpcd-VERSION:OS-RELEASE:MACHINE:PLATFORM.

signatures.label: embedded-linux
signatures.notes: BusyBox udhcpc: routers, cameras and other embedded Linux.
